result.summary: The page layout is largely sound, but two rendering problems stand out on the 'Popular right now' cards: a favorite (heart) button rendered dark-on-dark, and an implausible '-100%' discount badge. A minor inconsistency exists in the thumbnail treatment of the first 'Fastest near you' card.

issues.description: The favorite/heart button on the second 'Popular right now' card (pizza) is rendered as a dark heart on a dark circular background, making it nearly invisible, unlike the identical button on the ramen card which uses a white circle with a dark outline heart.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same white/translucent circular background and dark outlined heart styling used on the other cards, or invert the icon color so it meets contrast requirements against the badge background.

issues.description: The promotional badge on the pizza card reads '-100%', implying a completely free order, which is almost certainly a data/formatting error (e.g., a discount value being misinterpreted or unbounded).
issues.suggestion: Validate and clamp discount values before rendering, and format them as intended (e.g., '-50%' or 'Free item'); ensure 100% offers are explicitly labeled and intentional.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail in the 'Fastest near you' carousel uses a light gray background while the neighboring cards use dark photographic backgrounds, creating visual inconsistency; the white '15–25 min' time badge also has weak contrast against that light thumbnail.
issues.suggestion: Normalize thumbnail treatment (e.g., apply a consistent overlay/gradient) and ensure the time badge has a solid background or shadow so it remains legible on light images.
